tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Tokens authenticate crawler nodes and automation in namespace {{namespace}}. A token string is shown once, at creation, and never again.
tokens.noNamespace: Select a namespace to manage its API tokens.
tokens.emptyDescription: Create a token for a crawler node, a cookie refresher or a CI pipeline.
tokens.prefixHint: First characters of the token, for identification only
tokens.revokeDescription: Every node using this token is rejected immediately on all instances. Revocation cannot be undone; create a new token to restore access.

form.title: Create API token
form.description: The token is bound to namespace {{namespace}}.
form.name: Name
form.rateLimitHint: Per server instance; empty or 0 means unlimited.
form.ipAllowlistHint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges; empty allows any address.

errors.rateLimit: Enter a whole number between 0 and {{max}}.

ipAllowlist.invalid: Every entry must be an IP address or CIDR range.

expiresIn.invalid: Use a duration such as 30d or 12h, or leave empty for no expiry.
expiresIn.notPositive: The duration must be greater than zero.

secret.title: Token {{name}} created
secret.description: Copy the token now and store it in a secret manager.
secret.warning: This is the only time the token is shown. Spinneret stores only a hash; if you lose it, revoke the token and create a new one.
secret.usage: Nodes send it as the {{header}} header.
secret.confirm: I have saved the token in a safe place

lease_acquire.hint: Acquire leases on every site or only on one site.

report_write.hint: Report outcomes for every site or only for one site.

config_read.grants: Read config (node config service and admin reads)
config_read.hint: Optional group glob, e.g. crawler* ; empty means every group.

config_publish.hint: Optional group glob, e.g. crawler.* ; empty means every group.

identity_write.hint: Manage identities on every site or only on one site (e.g. cookie refreshers).

admin.grants: Admin role within the token namespace
admin.hint: Grants the admin role in the namespace. Use sparingly.

builder.empty: No scopes yet. Add a scope or start from a preset.
builder.sitesUnavailable: Sites could not be loaded; type site names instead.
builder.sitePlaceholder: Site name; empty for all sites

errors.argRequired: A path glob is required, e.g. {{namespace}}/signing/*
errors.argInvalid: Invalid argument: site names are exact (no wildcards), globs use letters, digits, ".", "_", "-", "*" and "?", and secret paths look like <namespace>/<path>.
errors.tooLong: The scope is longer than 256 characters.

summaries.viewer: Read-only access to scheduling state, config, dashboards and audit logs.
summaries.operator: Viewer plus day-to-day operations on identities, proxies, policies and breakers.
summaries.admin: Operator plus sites, publishing, secrets, reveals, tokens and notifications.
summaries.owner: Admin plus namespaces and user management.

descriptions.viewer: Reads namespaces, sites, identities, proxies, policies, breakers, config, dashboards, audit logs and notifications; lists secrets without values.
descriptions.operator: Everything a viewer can do, plus writing and operating identities and proxies, editing policies and config drafts, and operating breakers.
descriptions.admin: Everything an operator can do, plus managing sites, publishing policies and config, writing and revealing secrets, revealing identity payloads, managing API tokens and notification channels.
descriptions.owner: Everything an admin can do, plus creating and deleting namespaces and managing users and role bindings.

help.title: Roles
help.extraDescription: Add single sensitive permissions to any role without granting a higher role:
help.scope: A binding applies to all namespaces or to one namespace, optionally narrowed to some of its sites. Users and bindings can only be managed with a binding that covers the whole tenant.

password.hint: At least {{count}} characters. Longer passphrases with mixed characters are stronger.

users.title: Users & roles
users.description: Members of tenant {{tenant}} and their role bindings.
users.emptyDescription: Create a user to grant access to this tenant.
users.platformAdminHint: Manages tenants and can act in every tenant

username.pattern: Use 3–64 lower-case letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-", starting with a letter or digit.

create.title: Create user
create.description: The user gets an initial role binding in tenant {{tenant}}.
create.bindingDescription: More bindings can be added later from the user's role bindings.

edit.title: Edit {{username}}
edit.description: Profile fields apply to the user in every tenant.
edit.emailHint: Leave empty to clear the email address.
edit.disabledHint: Disabled users cannot sign in; disabling ends their sessions.

disable.title: Disable {{username}}?
disable.description: The user is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until the account is enabled again.

resetPassword.title: Reset password of {{username}}
resetPassword.description: Set a new password and share it with the user through a secure channel.
resetPassword.warning: All sessions of the user end immediately.

bindings.title: Role bindings of {{username}}
bindings.emptyDescription: Without a binding the user cannot access this tenant.
bindings.truncated: Only the first bindings are shown.
bindings.deleteDescription: {{username}} loses the {{role}} role on {{scope}}. The server refuses to remove the last owner of a tenant.
bindings.namespaceHint: Narrow the binding to one namespace, or grant it on all namespaces.
bindings.sitesHint: Restrict the binding to some sites of {{namespace}}; none selected means all sites.
bindings.sitesManualPlaceholder: Type site names and press Enter

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what, and whether it was allowed. Newest entries first.
audit.emptyDescription: Nothing matches the filters in the selected time range.

filters.rangeInvalid: The end must be after the start.
filters.rangeHint: Local time; leave a bound empty to keep it open.
